nina: Heads-up — us-west2 tiny-pod fragmentation spike. Lots of small jobs pinned to two old racks; eviction chatter up.
omar: saw it. Happens after the GPU-flavor-fallback we shipped yesterday; scheduler prefers flavor X which lives mostly on those racks.
li: Also seeing warm-pool attach jitter: p95 went 350ms -> 2.9s. Logs show conntrack spikes and NAT egress queueing in that AZ.
devbot: Alert: scheduler.p99_latency.us-west2 > 1400ms; pod_eviction_rate.us-west2 = 0.78%
nina: Quick mitigation idea: enable "soft-affinity-smoothing" that converts hard rack affinity to soft with weight for tiny-gang jobs for 30m. Scope via annotation `infra/pack-smooth=true`.
omar: Agree, and concurrently lower warmpool attach timeout from 25s -> 9s to free attach backlog. Risk: extra coldstart churn.
li: Can we also limit it to non-NVLINK workloads? Add selector `meta.annotations['infra/nvlink']='false'`.
nina: Plan: patch configmap then canary scheduler in us-west2a only. Command I'll run: ```kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra --type merge --patch '{"data":{"soft_affinity_smoothing":"true","smoothing_ttl":"30m","attach_timeout":"9s","nvlink_scope":"false"}}'```
ops-bot: Runbook check: CI green + oncall ack required.
devbot: CI: green for 8f3a. Oncall: @eng-oncall please ack.
omar: Oncall acked. Starting canary.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started by nina at 2890012355. Monitoring p99 latency, eviction-rate, egress.
li: 6m update: p99 down 1.45s -> 0.75s, evictions 0.78% -> 0.18%. egress delta estimate +1.4%. No NVLINK regressions observed.
omar: Good signal. Keep for 20m then decide to promote. Follow-up items: gate GPU-flavor-fallback rollout on rack-distribution metric and add node-label-sync acknowledgment in label-syncer.
nina: Filing SCHED-5301 for gating + conntrack tuning. If anything spikes, rollback to revert flags and restore attach_timeout=25s.
ops-bot: Ticket SCHED-5301 created by nina. Canary still healthy at 2890012370.
